text.p: Channel tunnel operator Eurotunnel said on Thursday it would seek financial compensation from construction consortium TransManche Link (TML) and expected to receive a "net positive contribution" from the consortium.
"We have decided to open...negotiations on the issues outstanding with (TML)," Eurotunnel chairman Patrick Ponsolle told shareholders' meeting.
"Do not ask me how much but you can be sure that even if it is below your expectations, Eurotunnel will get a net positive contribution from TML."

TML and Eurotunnel have been engaged in a long legal battle over cost overruns on construction of the tunnel, each blaming the other and both blaming the French and British governments for changing safety regulations during the construction period.
A vote on a proposed debt restructuring plan for Eurotunnel was to be put to the vote at the shareholders meeting later on Thursday.
